question: Who among the following was NOT included in the ICC Hall of Fame in August 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Graeme Smith.**__

__
 
• The International Cricket Council (ICC) inducted into the ICC Cricket Hall of Fame:
 
 
• South Africa's Jacques Kallis__,
 
• Australia's __Lisa Sthalekar,__ and
 
• Pakistan's __Zaheer Abbas__,
 
 
 
• **Hence Graeme Smith is the correct answer.**
